Weft TypeMachine Double Weft
Recommended3-4 bundles for full head
Co-wash or use sulfate-free shampoo. Deep condition weekly. Air dry or diffuse on low heat. Sleep with a silk/satin bonnet. Avoid heavy oils near the weft. Detangle from ends to roots with a wide-tooth comb. This hair can be flat-ironed, curled, and colored — treat it like your own natural hair.
Free standard shipping on orders over $200 via USPS Priority Mail (3-5 business days). Express shipping available at checkout. We offer a 30-day return policy on all unopened bundles. Hair must be in original packaging with tags attached. Custom-colored units are final sale.
For a natural, full look we recommend: 2-3 bundles for lengths 12"-18", 3-4 bundles for lengths 20"-26", and 4+ bundles for lengths 28"-30". Add a closure or frontal for the most seamless install. Our stylists are available via chat to help you choose the perfect combination.
